lessons.objective: Name familiar journeys, places, passengers and vehicle parts.
Compare road and rail vehicles, parts, routes and movement.
Compare watercraft, harbour places, wind and people power.
Compare aircraft and space vehicles, flight parts and take-off/landing.
Connect vehicles and workers with carrying, repair and helping tasks.
Recognise adult-supported safe journey choices and equipment.
